title: Delivering Boxes from Storage to Ports
description: Calculate minimum trips to deliver all boxes considering weight and count constraints.
pseudocode:
1. dp[i] = min trips for i boxes
2. Maintain a sliding window [j, i] s.t. sum weight <= maxWeight and count <= maxBoxes
3. Use monotonic deque to find min(dp[k] - k) efficiently
4. dp[i] = dp[j] + count(j...i) + 1

steps.note: Initialize dp array with infinity, dp[0] = 0.
Processing box 2, weight 2. Window [1, 2] is valid.
Processing box 3, weight 3. Window [1, 3] exceeds weight limit 3. Shrink window.
